data.content_ref: inline:The target's stated refutation condition directly undermines its own reduction thesis. SRC_003's divergence is explicitly anchored on 'misleading items' — items whose contextual absurdity renders the checklist itself wrong — while SRC_002 partitions items by action-coverage, i.e. items that merely require inference beyond explicit scope without any logical flaw in the checklist. Since the reduction requires the item-sets to be 'precisely' identical ('SRC_003's misleading items ARE precisely SRC_002's boundary-violating items'), the target simultaneously defines a clear disjunct: SRC_002's items involve the checklist being merely incomplete (correct as far as it goes) whereas SRC_003's items involve the checklist being logically flawed (wrong). A thing that is correct-but-incomplete is not identical to a thing that is wrong. Thus the relation is substantively self-refuting by its own stated criterion, not merely conditionally refutable.
